verdict.rationale: Solid's README explicitly states it has full SSR and serverless support, with streaming and progressive hydration 'to get to interactive as quickly as possible'. It also lists streaming SSR among its core features and describes isomorphic client/server rendering, which matches the story directly. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the streaming SSR APIs and setup (the evidence is only README-level claims), and independent or hands-on corroboration that streaming actually speeds up time-to-interactive.
